fusions.name: Bitter Extraction
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. A crushing blow that deals 18 damage and forces out every affliction on the target, adding 1.4 times the damage they had left and 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Sweat It Out
fusions.desc: Spends 4% of your maximum health to push poison out through your skin. It deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Takes Hold
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Spent Dose
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions on an enemy runs out, your physical damage rises by 25% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 10% poison resistance.
